scope: Prevent strict-complete DWG-to-DXF output from accepting an absent mandatory R2004+ AcDb:Template section while preserving tolerant reads.

sourceEvidence.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 22
sourceEvidence.finding: AcDb:Template is mandatory from R2004 (AC1018) onward; absence is optional for R13-R15.
sourceEvidence.implementationEffect: Reader remains tolerant and records TemplateMissing for mandatory-version absence. Strict-complete output rejects that diagnostic. Optional R13-R15 absence remains admitted.

coverage: A synthetic otherwise-complete read outcome with a TemplateMissing warning is refused by strict-complete output admission.
The existing destination sentinel remains byte-identical after refusal.
Existing TemplateDescriptionUnsupported strict refusal and tolerant parsing controls continue to pass.

validation.build: PASS: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests --parallel 4
validation.bindingNote: Focused selectors ran after rebuilding the touched targets against the current integrated worktree. Unrelated pending worktree edits were present; only Template hunks/files are staged in this slice.

remaining: This guard does not implement DXF serialization for Template description text, resolve the modern TU16 producer conflict, broaden producer qualification, or establish native template semantics.
